'''Club Esportiu Casa de Portugal''' is an Andorran [[association football|football]] club from [[Andorra la Vella]], founded in 2020. The club plays in the top-flight [[Primera Divisió]], having won promotion from the [[Segona Divisió]] in {{ill|Championnat d'Andorre de football de deuxième division 2025-2026|fr|lt=2025–26}}."}}
